text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So this is the current extent of my abilities…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to be so careless, especially not after discovering such a flaw in my calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Perhaps it'd be best if I go back to the drawing board and start from the ground up.
It'd be a shame if she abandoned all her hard work, but the choice is ultimately hers.
It'd be a shame if she abandoned all her hard work, but the choice is ultimately hers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I really appreciate you helping me with my theories and calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're right. The path to success is paved with failure. Nothing I've done has ever been a waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now, then! First, let's identify the parts of the strategy that did work. If we do that, then—
choice_data_list: Your next race will end in victory instead!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do whatever it takes to perfect my winning equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll strike the iron while it's hot and rework my calculations now while my memory of the race is still fresh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's head back right away… Wait—before we go back, I need to buy some bananas.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Because the glucose they provide is excellent for boosting brain function. They're essential for long brainstorming sessions.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: For the record… I don't want to buy them simply because I want to eat bananas!
Biwa Hayahide and I grab some bananas from the supermarket before heading back, and then we put in some long hours going over race data.
